content.short: Aragon is one of the oldest and most used DAO builders that enhances on-chain governance.
content.description: Aragon is one of the oldest and most widely used DAO builders, empowering many DAOs to organize their communities and economies on a modular governance platform. Founded in 2017 by Luis Cuende and Jorge Izquierdo, it was created to address government censorship of communities and to enable more open governance. The platform includes several sub-DAOs that support its operations, boosting efficiency, delegation, and treasury management across decentralized organizations.
